title: Scientific evidence and expert research map intake contract

research_question.description: Exposure/product, population, comparator, outcome and relevant period; identify scientific rather than advocacy framing.

source_manifest.description: Study/full-text, abstract and trial-registry records with identifiers, versions and access limits.

items.description: Source/record descriptor; resolve its identity, access and content via a host-validated adapter.

eligibility_protocol.description: Inclusion/exclusion criteria, search scope and handling of overlapping cohorts or multiple reports.

expert_report.description: Supplied report or claims to check; distinguish verification from new literature research.

$comment: The host must validate nested source descriptors against its actual DTOs. This specification deliberately does not fabricate production API shapes.
